name: Image Render
description: Ray trace POV-Ray 3.7 scene scripts in an isolated sandbox, resolve staged artifacts referenced by the scene, publish PNG renders, and look up POV-Ray syntax, examples, includes and CC0 assets locally.
capabilities: render 3D scenes and images from POV-Ray scene description scripts
ray trace photorealistic images with lights, materials, reflection, refraction
check POV-Ray scene syntax and report parse errors with line context
search the local POV-Ray 3.7 reference manual and tutorial for syntax
browse POV-Ray example scenes and standard include files
look up predefined POV-Ray colors, textures, finishes and macros
light scenes with CC0 HDRI environments and texture them with CC0 photos
place CC0 photoscanned props such as a chair, vase, lamp or crate in a scene
find and import any Poly Haven HDRI, texture or model on demand
use staged image, height-field and include file artifacts inside a scene
run long renders as durable background jobs and publish PNG artifacts
benchmark a node's ray tracing speed with the standard POV-Ray scene

assets.description: CC0 Poly Haven asset packs downloaded at installation with pinned SHA-256 hashes: hdri, textures, models, or ["none"] alone.

maxMemoryMb.description: Highest address-space limit for one render in MB. Omit to size it from node memory.

threads.description: POV-Ray render threads per render. Omit to use every CPU core.

maxTimeoutMs.description: Highest wall-clock limit for an immediate render. Omit for 10 minutes.

maxBackgroundTimeoutMs.description: Highest wall-clock limit for a render submitted as a background job, and its default. Omit for 4 hours.

concurrentRenders.description: Renders this node runs at once, immediate and background combined. Omit for one.

callsPerMinute.description: Render and check calls this installation accepts per minute.
